XCUIElementTypeStaticText.value: You are there before anyone else. The street is grey and quiet, the shutters along the row still down. You find the key, and it sticks for a second the way it always will, and then the door gives. Inside it smells of fresh paint and coffee. You stand on the threshold for a second, keys in hand, and let it be true: you have your own design studio with clients who trust your eye.

XCUIElementTypeStaticText.value: You turn the lights on one bank at a time and watch the room appear. Everything is where you left it last night, which still feels like a small miracle. Your eye goes to the bell above the door, and you stop to take it in. You stand in the middle of it all and breathe.

XCUIElementTypeStaticText.value: The first person through the door is a stranger who has been meaning to come in for weeks. They look around slowly and say it is lovely. You thank them like it is the first compliment anyone has ever paid you, because in this place it is. On the way out, they hold the door for someone else.

XCUIElementTypeStaticText.value: Not long ago you wrote “my own design studio, with clients who trust my eye” and sketched this room on the back of an envelope. You were not sure anyone would ever walk into it. You feel proud, so much it makes your hands shake. This is what your own design studio with clients who trust your eye felt like on the first morning: a door, and people walking through it.
